shared_elements: repeated linear/geometric patterning used as infill or bands
justification: The main overlap is only generic: both surfaces include profile animals and incised/repeated linear patterning on or around them. The biggest difference is that B shows a coherent horizontal procession of large, naturalistically rendered horned winged animals with human attendants/parts, while A is a much more schematic vertical composition of varied small animal/sign motifs arranged in stacked zones.
